root_cause: The SEO skill already preferred execution, but operator-facing daily runs could still end with a recommendation plus a vague statement that evidence was insufficient.
The runtime contract did not require a machine-readable terminal state with a reason code and exact missing evidence.

evidence.observed_failure: A material SEO/CRO opportunity was reported to the operator without a same-cycle implementation and without a standardized rejection reason contract.

prevention: Every material SEO/CRO opportunity terminates as EXECUTED or REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE.
Recommendation-only output is a contract failure.
Rejections require a bounded reason code plus exact missing/conflicting evidence and a future execution condition.
Safe reversible evidence-gated changes are executed up to the configured daily maximum.
Transient delivery failures remain recovery work and cannot be used as non-execution reasons.
